heading: INT. SALT MARSH RELAY STATION - DAY

units.text: INT. SALT MARSH RELAY STATION - DAY
A low adobe hut crouched among white crusted flats where nothing grows.
Inside: a plank table, a rusted stove, a calendar from three years ago.
Heat shimmers through a single dirty window.
Outside, a lone horse stands tied to a post, head hanging.
ROSALIE FENN, forties, the station keeper, wears a man's hat and a woman's pride.
A widow's ring on a chain around her neck.
She is scrubbing a tin plate when the door slams open.
THADDEUS "TAD" McCREADY, thirties, black duster gray with dust, a bandage dark with blood at his shoulder, falls across the threshold with a pistol in his fist.
Nobody move.
units.name: TAD

units.text: There's nobody to move, mister.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: I said nobody move!
units.name: TAD

units.text: He swings the pistol around the hut, corner to corner, finds only a cat on the sill.
Then Rosalie.
You're bleeding on my floor.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: Where's the stage?
units.name: TAD

units.text: Gone through at noon. Won't be back till Thursday.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: Thursday.
units.name: TAD

units.text: It's Tuesday. Put the gun down and sit.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: Lord help me.
units.name: TAD

units.text: He doesn't put it down.
His hand wobbles.
Sweat runs into his eyes.
She sets the plate on the table and slowly dries her hands on her apron.
I've seen men bleed. I've seen men run. I've never seen one do both and keep hold of a gun.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: You calling me a fool?
units.name: TAD

units.text: I'm calling you a patient. Sit.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: The pistol drops to his side.
He sits.
The chair shrieks.
She pulls a bottle from under the stove and pours into a cracked cup.
Drink.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: He does.
His shoulders loosen.
She kneels to unwind the bandage.
There's three men behind me.
units.name: TAD

units.text: Then we'll want to be quick.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: She works.
The cat watches.
Outside, the horse snorts and stamps once, and a thin line of dust rises on the horizon.
Always three.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: She ties off the bandage and takes a rifle down from the rafters.
